verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a public REST API with per-endpoint reference pages covering inference and management of models, deployments and datasets. The API is OpenAI-compatible, and a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec is listed in llms.txt. The probe's 404s on generic openapi.json paths only show the spec lives at a different URL (gateway.openapi.yaml), not that it is absent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: It also lets you automate management of models, deployments, datasets, and more.
